requirements.title: Durable development identity
requirements.statement: A development/change effort has a stable identity independent of worker, worktree, branch, PR, claim, or transport.

requirements.title: Immutable accepted specification revisions
requirements.statement: Accepted behavior/instructions are represented by immutable SpecRevision identities; changes create explicit revisions.

requirements.title: Material ambiguity blocks acceptance
requirements.statement: Unresolved contradictions or material ambiguity remain explicit and cannot be hidden by accepting a document shell.

requirements.title: Framework-neutral artifact authority
requirements.statement: Canonical artifact authority is based on typed roles, identity, revision and provenance rather than a framework-specific filesystem root.

requirements.title: Dependency-aware durable work packages
requirements.statement: Accepted work can be decomposed into durable WorkPackages with explicit dependencies and cycle detection.

requirements.title: Frozen executable assignment
requirements.statement: An Assignment binds exact WorkPackage, SpecRevision, context/scope, criteria and execution constraints without later silent mutation.

requirements.title: No vacuous assignment acceptance
requirements.statement: An Assignment with zero applicable mandatory criteria cannot be accepted or graded successful.

requirements.title: Bounded provenance-bearing context bundle
requirements.statement: Assignments provide sufficient bounded context with source provenance, prerequisites, exclusions and allowed/forbidden work surfaces.

requirements.title: Replaceable execution attempts
requirements.statement: Each worker execution episode has a durable Attempt identity distinct from Assignment and worker identity.

requirements.title: Temporary explicit execution authority
requirements.statement: Claims/leases grant bounded temporary authority, expire/reap explicitly, and do not define durable work identity.

requirements.title: Authority is not inherited by replacement
requirements.statement: Replacement workers receive newly authorized claims/credentials; transfer does not implicitly inherit unrelated authority.

requirements.title: Execution isolation is explicit
requirements.statement: Worktree/sandbox/resource boundaries are attached to Attempts and prevent accidental cross-attempt mutation where the profile requires isolation.

requirements.title: Exact candidate identity
requirements.statement: Produced work is represented by an exact immutable candidate reference sufficient for independent evaluation and promotion.

requirements.title: Independent exact-candidate evaluation
requirements.statement: Evaluation binds exact Assignment/SpecRevision/Candidate and evaluator identity/version and records criterion-level outcomes.

requirements.title: Worker cannot self-award terminal acceptance
requirements.statement: Worker completion/self-report cannot substitute for the independent accepted evaluation boundary.

requirements.title: Evaluator failure is non-green
requirements.statement: Unavailable, failed, cancelled or mismatched required evaluation yields explicit non-success semantics.

requirements.title: Evaluation evidence receipts are attributable
requirements.statement: Evaluation retains raw/derived evidence references, verifier context and enough provenance for audit/replay/reassessment.

requirements.title: Accepted work requires correctness and governance
requirements.statement: Terminal accepted work requires mandatory criterion satisfaction plus applicable governance/authority permission.

requirements.title: Review/CI alone are insufficient
requirements.statement: Review approval, CI green, policy presence or merge alone cannot award AcceptedWork.

requirements.title: Policy permission and correctness proof remain separate
requirements.statement: GovernanceContract cannot substitute for criterion grading and grading cannot bypass policy.

requirements.title: Promotion uses the evaluated candidate
requirements.statement: Promotion/ship/integration operates on the exact accepted candidate and fails if it changed or acceptance became stale.

requirements.title: Promotion fails closed
requirements.statement: Merge conflict, transport error, missing authority or stale/invalid acceptance prevents promotion.

requirements.title: Durable recovery without owner replay
requirements.statement: Accepted specs, DAG, assignments, attempts, claims, candidates, evaluations and decisions are recoverable enough to continue after interruption.

requirements.title: Adaptive methodology profiles
requirements.statement: Workflow profiles may vary research/design/planning depth while preserving semantic prerequisites for acceptance.

requirements.title: Provenance-preserving framework harmonization
requirements.statement: External framework artifacts map into canonical roles/identities with aliases/provenance and explicit conflict handling.

requirements.title: Imports cannot create competing accepted intent
requirements.statement: Equivalent/imported artifacts do not create parallel accepted authorities; conflicts require explicit reconciliation.

requirements.title: Versioned Tracera evidence handoff
requirements.statement: AgilePlus can export exact work/evaluation evidence references to Tracera without asserting product satisfaction.

requirements.title: AgilePlus acceptance remains standalone
requirements.statement: AgilePlus can evaluate/recover its own work when Tracera is unavailable; federation failure does not erase work truth.

requirements.title: Work acceptance is not product satisfaction
requirements.statement: Tracera independently decides product-level applicability/acceptance of AgilePlus evidence.

requirements.title: Interface semantic parity
requirements.statement: Supported CLI/API/MCP/human surfaces expose matching canonical identities, revisions, status and acceptance meaning.

requirements.title: Interfaces fail truthfully
requirements.statement: Invalid, unauthorized, missing, stale, dependency and internal failures cannot be represented as successful work state.

requirements.title: Historical audit-hash-v1 envelope is explicit
requirements.statement: v1 verification covers only its actual transition-core fields and documentation does not claim broader tamper evidence.

requirements.title: Versioned stronger audit receipts
requirements.statement: Future audit-hash-v2 defines canonical serialization, covered fields, immutable evidence/evaluation references and cross-version verification without rewriting v1 history.

requirements.title: Bidirectional work traceability
requirements.statement: Durable links connect intent/spec/work/assignment/attempt/candidate/evaluation/evidence/promotion in both explanatory directions.

requirements.title: Supersession preserves history
requirements.statement: Revisions, assignment supersession, failed attempts, rejected evaluations and promotions remain attributable rather than overwritten.
